gloss: kitchen paper towel; paper towel (for cooking)

definitions.gloss: kitchen paper towel; paper towel (for cooking)

examples.japanese: キッチンペーパーで{油|あぶら}を{拭|ふ}く。
examples.english: Wipe up the oil with a paper towel.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}はキッチンペーパーの{上|うえ}に{置|お}いて{油|あぶら}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: Place fried food on kitchen paper to drain the oil.

examples.japanese: {豆腐|とうふ}をキッチンペーパーで{包|つつ}んで{電子|でんし}レンジで{温|あたた}めると、{簡単|かんたん}に{水切|みずき}りができる。
examples.english: If you wrap tofu in kitchen paper and microwave it, you can easily drain the water.

notes:
A wasei-eigo (Japanese-coined English) term. In English, these are usually called "paper towels," while "kitchen paper" is more common in British English. In Japan, キッチンペーパー specifically refers to absorbent paper used in cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キッチンペーパーで{拭|ふ}く: to wipe with kitchen paper
- キッチンペーパーで{油|あぶら}を{切|き}る: to drain oil with kitchen paper
- キッチンペーパーで{水気|みずけ}を{取|と}る: to pat dry with kitchen paper
- キッチンペーパーで{包|つつ}む: to wrap in kitchen paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペーパータオル: paper towel — sometimes used interchangeably, but can also refer to hand-drying towels in restrooms
- ティッシュ: tissue — thinner and used for wiping the face or nose, not for cooking
- クッキングシート: cooking sheet, parchment paper — used for baking, not absorbing
